homeTitle: ACBuy Spreadsheet | Product Links, QC Photos & Price Checks
homeDesc: Browse ACBuy spreadsheet finds by category. Open the original product record, compare the listed price and check what to do if a link or payment fails.
heroCopy: Browse eight sample finds below or search the full catalog. Each card links to a product record where you can check the item, size and current price.
catalogCopy: Prices and gallery counts are snapshots from the date on each card. Open a listing to check its current options.
homeResearchTitle: Check a link, payment or order
linkStatus: Check new orders, stored items and parcels separately.
linkPay: Check your payment options, final currency and any pending charge.
linkSource: Trace a spreadsheet row back to its Taobao, Weidian or 1688 listing.
guideTitle: How to Use an ACBuy Spreadsheet and Verify a Product Link
guideDesc: Follow one ACBuy spreadsheet row from the source item ID to the selected size, seller listing and warehouse QC photo.
researchNote: Use the sources below alongside the information shown for your own item, order or parcel.
hubIntro: Looking for a product? Start with the spreadsheet. For an order already in progress, choose the guide for its current stage: payment, warehouse photos, packing or delivery.
hubTitle: ACBuy Guides | Service Status, Payments, Product Links & Shipping
photoNote: Open the warehouse record for this item to see which photos are included and whether an extra angle or measurement is available. Before shipping, compare the pictured label and any visible measurements with the variant you ordered.
storageNote: Check the storage deadline displayed for each item before waiting for another order. If a deadline is missing or conflicts with an older guide, ask support to confirm it using the warehouse reference.
workflow: Use the product record, warehouse photos and parcel quote to follow each stage. Check the status guide before starting a new purchase.
